subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A coastal museum displayed a bell from an old ship.”?
options: Visitors could see how people once had to line up, show papers, and answer questions.
Students tried to imagine school life when every sound depended on a person pulling a rope.
Visitors could not ring it, but they could listen to a recording of its sound.
Some old things do not sound perfect, but they carry voices that new things cannot."
